value.rationale: This natural infinite family gives a complete, length-refined antidictionary classification, including arbitrary integer run lengths and an unexpected cyclic-order invariance. The exact obstruction set defines the full periodic factorial language; it is not a fixed input numerical enumeration, trivial renaming, or a single narrow parameter slice. It includes previously known permutation-run and binary boundary cases only as credited specializations.
